candidates.description: Pomerium from 0.30.0 before 0.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the MCP token endpoint that skips client secret verification for client_secret_basic clients. Attackers holding an intercepted authorization code or refresh token can redeem it at /.pomerium/mcp/token with any secret to obtain the victim's access tokens.

candidates.description: Gradio 6.27.0 before 6.32.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in gradio/history.py that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to use the operator's locally saved Hugging Face token by sending a forged Host: localhost header. When ssr_mode is enabled, requests proxied through the local Node SSR server pass the loopback check, letting attackers call run history endpoints to list buckets, read records and assets, and write buckets under the operator's account.

candidates.description: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

kev_ai.name: Project MONAI MONAI Label Path Traversal Vulnerability
kev_ai.description: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.
